industries: Banking transformation portfolios, healthcare and transit programs, and Canada's largest tech ecosystem drive hiring.
intro:
Toronto is Canada's project capital by weight of institutions: the Big Five banks run their transformation portfolios from Bay Street, the province's healthcare and transit programs are among North America's largest, and a tech ecosystem behind only the Valley and NYC keeps hiring delivery leads. Canadian employers are famously credential-conscious — PMP appears in postings as a requirement, not a preference, and newcomers use it to localize international experience. Batches are scheduled live online across the whole year at hours built for Toronto: a weekend Sat–Sun cohort and a weekday Wed–Thu cohort each week, all landing in comfortable local daytime; every upcoming date and its exact Toronto timing is listed in the schedule below. The format never changes: live weekend instruction, exam application support, full-length mock exams, and trainer access until you pass.

Toronto runs Canada's program budgets: the five big banks fund perpetual regulatory and platform change, the telecom and retail head offices layer their own portfolios on top, and the tech corridor to Waterloo adds product delivery demand. Certification is standard screening currency across all of it — Toronto recruiters check for it reflexively. The course is live online across two consecutive days shown in Toronto local time on this page, no Union Station required. Canadian compensation for certified project professionals concentrates here; the sourced Toronto entries in the salary table below give named, dated figures for negotiation. The employer list reflects the banking-telecom-tech demand base, and institutions can certify entire change teams through private cohorts.
